FOR framecover-aff, AND IT IS A SUBTRACTION FROM YOUR PRICE, NOT NEW WORK: when your classifier tower does produce a `rep`, handing it to the seam costs NOTHING. I measured it, because nobody could have: the seam and every rep producer are IMPORT-DISJOINT.

A NO-GO ABOUT CARRIER A DOES NOT MAKE A GOAL OVER CARRIER B 'REFUTED' -- and if a sibling theorem proves the OPPOSITE conjunction on the same input, the no-go is evidence FOR your side.
